en: The Path of Discrimination 1,
Great Chapter 1.7.
Discourse on Karma
There was karma; there was the ripening of that karma.
There was karma; there was no ripening of that karma.
There was karma; there is the ripening of that karma.
Action occurred, but there is no ripening of action.
Action occurred, and there will be a ripening of action.
Action occurred, but there will not be a ripening of action.
(Regarding past karma:
There is karma; there is the ripening of karma.
There is karma; there is no ripening of karma.
There is action; there will be the ripening of that action.
There is action; there will not be the ripening of that action. (Present action.)
There will be karma; there will be the ripening of that karma.
There will be karma; there will not be the ripening of that karma. (Future karma.)
There was wholesome kamma; there was the ripening of wholesome kamma.
There was wholesome kamma; there was no ripening of wholesome kamma.
There was wholesome kamma; there is the ripening of wholesome kamma.
Wholesome kamma occurred; there is no result of wholesome kamma.
Wholesome kamma occurred; there will be a result of wholesome kamma.
Wholesome kamma occurred; there will not be a result of wholesome kamma.
There is wholesome kamma; there is the result of wholesome kamma.
There is wholesome kamma; there is no result of wholesome kamma.
There is wholesome kamma; there will be a result of wholesome kamma.
There is wholesome kamma; there will not be a result of that wholesome kamma.
There will be wholesome kamma; there will be a result of that wholesome kamma.
There will be wholesome kamma; there will not be a result of that wholesome kamma.
There was unwholesome kamma; there was the result of unwholesome kamma.
There was unwholesome kamma; there was no result of unwholesome kamma.
There was unwholesome kamma; there is the result of unwholesome kamma.
“Unwholesome kamma occurred; there is no result of unwholesome kamma.
“Unwholesome kamma occurred; there will be a result of unwholesome kamma.
“Unwholesome kamma occurred; there will not be a result of unwholesome kamma.”
There is unwholesome kamma; there is the result of unwholesome kamma.
There is unwholesome kamma; there is no result of unwholesome kamma.
There is unwholesome kamma; there will be a result of unwholesome kamma.
There is unwholesome kamma; there will not be the ripening of that unwholesome kamma.
There will be unwholesome kamma; there will be the ripening of that unwholesome kamma.
There will be unwholesome kamma; there will not be the ripening of that unwholesome kamma.
There was blameable karma... [etc. ...
there was blameless karma... [etc. ...
there was dark karma... [etc.]...
There was white karma...
[as above] ...there was karma with a pleasant result...
[as above] ...there was karma with a painful result... [as above].
There was karma with pleasant ripening...
[and so on] ...there was karma with painful ripening, and there was the ripening of that karma with painful ripening.
There was karma with painful ripening, but there was no ripening of that karma with painful ripening.
There was karma with painful result; there is the result of karma with painful result.
There was karma with painful result; there is no result of karma with painful result.
There was karma with painful result; there will be the result of karma with painful result.
There was karma with painful result, but there will not be a result of that karma with painful result.
There is karma with painful result, and there is a result of that karma with painful result.
There is karma with painful result, but there is no result of that karma with painful result.
There is karma with a painful result; there will be a result for that karma with a painful result.
There is karma with a painful result; there will not be a result for that karma with a painful result.
There is karma with a painful result; there will be a result for that karma with a painful result.
"There will be karma with a painful result, but there will not be a result for that karma which has a painful result.
The Discussion on Karma is finished.
